registered: experiments/nhl/stage58/registry.json (registered 2026-10-05, before any NHL pick was saved)

baseline.name: stage56_confirmation
baseline.label: Model A on the 2024-25 and 2025-26 confirmation seasons, with each game's actual starting goalie

rule.flag_when: at each checkpoint, the first that many graded picks in the order their games started: the lower end of the one-sided 99% bootstrap interval of mean per-game log loss is above the baseline. 99% is the one-sided 95% shared equally among the five checkpoints (Bonferroni: 5% / 5 = 1% each). A flag at any checkpoint stands for the season.
rule.amended: 2026-11-04, Stage 85 item 1 of the 2026-11-02 review (drift.amended_2026_11_04 in the registry). Until then the check tested every graded pick at one-sided 95% at every daily run once min_games picks were graded.

by_look_source: experiments/nhl/stage56/results/model_a_by_season.json, by_look: Model A's log loss over each confirmation season's first n games (the history orders a season's games by day, then game id), pooled
amended_by_look: 2026-11-11, Stage 95 item 31 (audit 7, M4; drift.amended_2026_11_11 in the registry): each look at n graded picks is held to the backtest over a season's first n games, not over whole seasons.
